projects.name: AI-Native Enterprise Control Tower
projects.purpose: CAIO-facing console connecting organization, workforce, processes, agents, harnesses, D2D delivery, value realization, token economics and strategy into one product.

tech_details.React 19: UI runtime. Components are .jsx; the data and logic layer is TypeScript.
tech_details.React Router 7 (hash router): createHashRouter, so the prototype serves from any static path without server rewrites.
tech_details.Astryx (@astryxdesign/core): MIT design system, themed with DEWA green #007560 via data-astryx-theme.
tech_details.recharts: Every chart. Marks use the dataviz reference palette, not brand hex — brand colours fail perceptual distinctness for chart series.
tech_details.@xyflow/react: Node-link graphs: org chart, harness designer, strategy map, and the 403-node Enterprise Map.
tech_details.@dagrejs/dagre: Auto-layout for every graph, shared through one helper (pages/organization/orgLayout.ts).
tech_details.In-memory mock dataset: 14 seed files in strict foreign-key order, served through data/mockApi.ts — the only data door the UI may use.
tech_details.Seeded PRNG (mulberry32): Seed 42, so every run, screenshot and test is reproducible.
tech_details.No backend: Deliberate. The requirements doc mandates a frontend-only first prototype: no API keys, no paid dependencies.
tech_details.vitest: 108 data-layer tests covering graph integrity, lens purity, formulas and foreign keys.
tech_details.Puppeteer verification scripts: frontend/scripts/*.mjs — 45 UI checks plus the UX checklist, accessibility, responsiveness and keyboard navigation.
